# American Airlines
> Official American Airlines website for booking flights, managing trips, checking in, and accessing travel policies, loyalty, and support.

AA.com is the primary customer platform for American Airlines, covering reservations, AAdvantage loyalty, travel information, baggage policies, check-in, flight status, and self-service support for domestic and international travelers.

## Booking & Trip Management
- [Book Flights](https://www.aa.com/booking/find-flights): Search and book American Airlines flights and fares.
- [Manage Trips / Check-in](https://www.aa.com/reservation/view/find-your-trip): Retrieve reservations to manage flights, seats, and services.
- [Flight Status](https://www.aa.com/travelInformation/flights/status): Check real-time departure, arrival, and delay information.
- [Check-in](https://www.aa.com/checkin/viewCheckin): Check in online and access boarding passes before departure.
- [Seats](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/experience/seats.jsp): Review seat options, cabin seating, and seat selection details.
- [Same-day Travel Changes](https://www.aa.com/i18n/plan-travel/extras/same-day-travel.jsp): Learn rules and options for same-day flight changes and standby.

## Baggage
- [Baggage Information](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/baggage/baggage.jsp): Overview of checked, carry-on, and special baggage policies.
- [Checked Bag Policy](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/baggage/checked-baggage-policy.jsp): Rules, size limits, and allowances for checked bags.
- [Carry-on Bags](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/baggage/carry-on-baggage.jsp): Carry-on size limits, personal item rules, and restrictions.
- [Bag and Optional Service Fees](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/fees.jsp): View baggage fees and other optional travel charges.
- [Delayed or Damaged Bags](https://centralbaggage.aa.com/en-US/?from=selfServiceCallouts-BG-DLD_OVER): Self-service portal for delayed, damaged, or missing baggage support.
- [Restricted Items](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/baggage/restricted-items.jsp): Find prohibited and restricted items for checked and carry-on bags.

## Travel Information & Policies
- [Travel Information](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/travel-tools/travel-information.jsp): Central hub for airport, onboard, and travel policy information.
- [Travel Alerts](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/travel-alerts.jsp): Current waivers, disruptions, and operational travel notices.
- [Passport and Visa Requirements](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/international-travel/international-travel.jsp): International travel requirements and document guidance.
- [Children and Infants](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/special-assistance/traveling-children.jsp): Policies and guidance for children traveling with or without adults.
- [Pets](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/special-assistance/pets.jsp): Rules and options for traveling with pets.
- [Special Assistance](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/special-assistance/special-assistance.jsp): Accessibility services and assistance for travelers with disabilities.

## AAdvantage Loyalty
- [AAdvantage Overview](https://www.aa.com/aadvantage-program/profile/overview): Access and manage AAdvantage account information.
- [AAdvantage Program](https://www.aa.com/i18n/aadvantage-program/aadvantage-program.jsp): Learn about earning, redeeming, and program benefits.
- [Earn Miles](https://www.aa.com/i18n/aadvantage-program/miles/earn/special-partners.jsp): Explore ways to earn AAdvantage miles with partners and travel.
- [Redeem Miles](https://www.aa.com/i18n/aadvantage-program/miles/redeem/redeem-miles.jsp): Use miles for flights, upgrades, and other rewards.
- [AAdvantage Status](https://www.aa.com/i18n/aadvantage-program/status/aadvantage-status.jsp): Review elite status tiers, Loyalty Points, and benefits.
- [Mileage Partners](https://www.aa.com/i18n/aadvantage-program/miles/partners/partner-airlines.jsp): Browse airline and non-airline partners in the loyalty ecosystem.

## Credit Cards & Vacations
- [AAdvantage Credit Cards](https://creditcards.aa.com/): Explore co-branded credit cards and cardmember benefits.
- [American Airlines Vacations](https://www.aavacations.com/): Book vacation packages including flights, hotels, cars, and activities.
- [Hotels](https://www.aa.com/hotels/): Search hotel booking options connected to American Airlines travel.
- [Cars](https://www.aa.com/car/): Reserve rental cars through American Airlines travel partners.
- [Cruises](https://www.aacruises.com/): Browse cruise vacations and loyalty-related offers.

## Customer Service & Self-Service
- [Help Center](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/contact-american/american-customer-service.jsp): Contact options and customer service resources.
- [Refunds](https://prefunds.aa.com/refunds/): Request and track eligible ticket refunds online.
- [Receipts and Refunds](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/support/receipts-and-refunds.jsp): Find receipt, refund, and payment support information.
- [Lost and Found](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/support/lost-and-found.jsp): Guidance for items lost onboard or at the airport.
- [Customer Relations](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/support/customer-relations.jsp): Submit compliments, complaints, and post-travel feedback.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/support/faqs.jsp): Browse common questions about travel, booking, and service.

## Airport & Onboard Experience
- [Admirals Club](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/clubs/admirals-club.jsp): Learn about lounge access, membership, and club locations.
- [Flagship Lounge](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/clubs/flagship-lounge.jsp): Premium lounge access and eligible traveler information.
- [Inflight Entertainment](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/experience/entertainment.jsp): Overview of onboard entertainment and streaming options.
- [Wi-Fi and Connectivity](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/experience/wi-fi-and-connectivity.jsp): Details on inflight Wi-Fi availability and usage.
- [Food and Drinks](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/experience/dining.jsp): Cabin dining and beverage service information.
- [Premium Cabins](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/experience/travel-experience.jsp): Compare onboard experiences across cabins and routes.

## Destinations & Route Planning
- [Destinations](https://www.aa.com/en-us/flights-to): Explore destinations served by American Airlines.
- [Route Map](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/route-map.jsp): View route network and destination coverage.
- [Deals and Offers](https://www.aa.com/i18n/book-travel/book-flight/flight-deals.jsp): Browse current airfare promotions and travel deals.
- [Where We Fly](https://www.aa.com/i18n/travel-info/where-we-fly.jsp): Review regions, cities, and network reach.
- [Vacation Inspiration](https://www.aavacations.com/deals): Discover travel package deals and destination offers.

## Business & Corporate Travel
- [Business Programs](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/business-programs/business-programs.jsp): Overview of corporate and business travel offerings.
- [Business Extra](https://www.businessextra.com/): Corporate travel rewards program for eligible businesses.
- [Meetings and Groups](https://www.aa.com/i18n/customer-service/business-programs/meetings-and-groups.jsp): Support and programs for group and meeting travel.
- [Cargo](https://www.aacargo.com/): American Airlines Cargo services for shipping and logistics.
- [Travel Agency Reference](https://saleslink.aa.com/en-US/home.html): Sales and support resources for travel advisors and agencies.
